name: find-tool
title: Find Tool
description: Searches the real tools folder by current domain, function family, settings text, description, and metadata. Discovery never grants execution authority.

settings.name: query
settings.title: Query
settings.description: Words or phrase used to discover Tools.

settings.name: domain
settings.title: Domain
settings.description: Optional hard domain boundary. Base remains available.

settings.name: function_prefix
settings.title: Function Prefix
settings.description: Optional functional prefix such as find, list, load, view, check, add, remove, update, or delete.

settings.name: include_stamps
settings.title: Include Stamps
settings.description: Allow template-producing stamp-* capabilities in results.
